name: 25/10 Crowd Sourcing
deliverable: High-velocity anonymous card exchange scoring boldest breakthrough ideas

steps.text: Each person writes a bold action for the bottleneck and its first step on an unsigned card.
Draw five scoring rows, one per shuffle round.
Run five blind rounds, scoring each card 1 to 5.
Count from 25 down, reading the top-scoring cards.

failure: Scorers cluster on safe threes, so every card lands near 15 and bold ideas look merely polite.
intervention: Say a three is a refusal to judge; score a platitude one, brave and actionable ideas five.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.
